latest_release.name: v0.26.6
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* chore: Refactor fast-field and heap column resolution. by @barbarj in https://github.com/paradedb/paradedb/pull/7240
* ci: backport extension smoke-test runner fix to 0.26.x by @philippemnoel in https://github.com/paradedb/paradedb/pull/7250
* fix: use system Git for macOS release checkouts by @philippemnoel in https://github.com/paradedb/paradedb/pull/7251
* chore: Generate Dockerfiles for v0.26.5 by @paradedb-github-bot[bot] in https://github.com/paradedb/paradedb/pull/7252
* feat: Add support for joins ordered by vector distance by @stuhood in https://github.com/paradedb/paradedb/pull/7268
* ci: Restore rolling RunsOn image by @allyn-bottorff in https://github.com/paradedb/paradedb/pull/7270
* ci: Enable RunsOn git and apt caches by @philippemnoel in https://github.com/paradedb/paradedb/pull/7278
* perf: keep the rank join when a leaf carries a pushed filter such as a row-level security policy by @mithuncy in https://github.com/paradedb/paradedb/pull/7303
* fix: polish RankJoin eligibility, planner warnings, and parameterized score projections by @stuhood in https://github.com/paradedb/paradedb/pull/7323


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/paradedb/paradedb/compare/v0.26.5...v0.26.6
